name: Wonderhop
summary: Wonderhop is a free daily survey and trivia game played in the browser. Every day, everyone gets the same four short games of seven questions, such as "Name a summer fruit". In Sky you give the answer most people give, in Abyss the rarest valid answer, in Past the oldest thing and in Future the most recent one. Any real answer counts: each question has a long list of known answers, and an AI judge checks the others and explains in one sentence why an answer is refused. Retro pixel art, an original soundtrack, daily and weekly leaderboards, streaks and a shareable result card. No account, no download, no ads. Available in 9 languages.
